title: FRIDAY Voice reading fixture: 50 reply lines, written for this repository, no audio
note: text is what FRIDAY says; spoken is the same line as a listener should hear it (digits, times, rupees and units as words). A line with a digit also lists numberLangs: the language each number is read in, by the neighbouring word (script-policy spanTreatments). kernelReads names the lines where the kernel front end reads a number in the other language today.
